<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — Both pacedPoints and histogramBin now floor through floorAtEdge(quotient + FIXED_CONSTANTS.bandEdgeEpsilon). bandEdgeEpsilon = 1e-9 is a new FIXED_CONSTANTS key, and a new test asserts it. No bare Math.floor of a quotient is left in either function.
- A2: met — paced-edges.test.ts goes through scorePaced, using transition times and levels. It covers 5-5 at ±j×0.5 s, 2-2 at ±j×0.2 s, peaks at 3+j×0.3 % and troughs at -3-j×0.3 %, each expecting 10-j points. It also includes the named 3.3 % → 9 and 5.1 % → 3 regression cases.
- A3: met — Edges -1..+1 in 0.25 steps are built from levels. Each one is checked directly against histogramBin and also through the scorePaced histogram. The expected bin is min(i, last), so +1 lands in the last bin.
- A4: unverified — No existing tests or goldens are touched, and config.ts only gains a key. The lint, typecheck and test results were not part of this review, so pass/fail comes from the deterministic check stage.

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._
